tagline: World's largest recreational boat and yacht retailer, marina operator, and superyacht services company.
hero_kpi_rationale: Total revenue reflects the scale of MarineMax's operations as the world's largest recreational boat retailer and marina operator, encompassing new and used boat sales, related services, and marina activities.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total sales revenue from new and used boat sales, marine products, repair and maintenance services, marina operations, and superyacht services.
kpis.description: Represents the total business volume of the company, including boat sales, parts, accessories, marina operations, and yacht services.
kpis.signal: Global market leader in recreational boating retail.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, before deduction of other operating expenses.
kpis.description: Indicates the direct profitability of product and service sales.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue, measuring the profitability of core operations.
kpis.description: Reflects the company's efficiency in managing operating costs to generate profits.

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.explanation: Capital investments in digital platforms, technology development, and product innovation initiatives.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's commitment to innovation through digital transformation and technology platforms such as Boatyard and Boatzon.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Total capital spending on property, plant, equipment, marina facilities, and acquisitions.
kpis.description: Measures investments in long-term assets such as retail locations, marinas, and infrastructure.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees across all retail locations, marinas, manufacturing facilities, and service operations.
kpis.description: Indicator of organization size and workforce requirements across 120+ worldwide locations.

risks.title: Brunswick Manufacturer Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on Brunswick for new boat sales, representing approximately 18% of revenue in fiscal 2025. Disruption of this relationship could significantly impact business operations.

risks.title: Increased Market Competition
risks.score_rationale: The recreational boating market is highly competitive with numerous market participants. Intensifying competition could result in price pressures and margin compression.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has completed multiple acquisitions in recent years, including IGY Marinas, Cruisers Yachts, and other strategic purchases. Integration challenges, asset impairment, and goodwill write-downs pose financial risks.

risks.title: Economic Cycle Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company's business is highly dependent on economic conditions and consumer discretionary spending. Economic recession would significantly impact recreational boat sales.

risks.title: Regulatory and Environmental Compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company operates under marine and environmental regulations. Non-compliance could result in penalties and operational restrictions.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates digital platforms (Boatyard, Boatzon, Boatzon marketplace) and customer-facing systems. Cybersecurity breaches could compromise customer data and disrupt operations.

risks.title: Reputation and Service Quality Risks
risks.score_rationale: As the market leader in recreational boating retail, the company faces elevated reputational risks from product quality issues, customer service failures, or litigation.

ai_positioning.summary: MarineMax does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K filing. Technology investments focus on digital customer experience platforms (Boatyard, Boatzon) rather than AI.
